unreal_bridge_notes.nexus_approach: NexusBridge.swift replaces UnrealManager. Uses HTTP poll against /api/debug/latest-system-scan and /api/debug/match/{match_id}/payload for system-scan and match state.
unreal_bridge_notes.ws_integration: Nexus can also subscribe to /ws/match/{match_id} for push-based events.
